series.label: Real personal income (millions of constant (2017) dollars) 1/ · BEA annual history
series.definition: Published BEA annual values, 2008–2024. RPPs compare geographic price levels relative to the national base; RPP changes alone are not local inflation.
limitations: Tables SARPP, SAIRPD and SARPI have different price-level and constant-dollar meanings; do not substitute one for another.
series.hosted_scope_note: All retained observations for this measure in the named built-in dataset. Native dates, reporting populations and unavailable/source-ineligible values remain unchanged.
